objects.name: AFRINTEL monthly CTI report - February 2026
objects.description:
# AFRINTEL CTI report - cyber incidents in Africa (February 2026)

This validated corpus contains **21 incidents or documented cases** first published or first observed by AFRINTEL in February 2026. The month assignment follows the publication or first documented observation date; a compromise date is not inferred when it is unavailable.

## Validated monthly breakdown

| Incident type | Count | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ransomware | 20 | 100.0% |
| Data Leak | 1 | 4.8% |
| **Total** | **21** | **100.0%** |

## Countries most represented

| Country | Count |
|---|---:|
| Égypte | 4 |
| Afrique du Sud | 3 |
| Ghana | 2 |
| Nigeria | 2 |
| Somalie | 1 |
| Sénégal | 1 |
| Tanzanie | 1 |
| Kenya | 1 |
| Maurice | 1 |
| Tunisie | 1 |
| Soudan | 1 |
| Côte d'Ivoire | 1 |
| Maroc | 1 |
| Namibie | 1 |

## Actor labels most represented

| Actor label | Count |
|---|---:|
| TheGentlemen | 5 |
| 0APT | 3 |
| LockBit 5.0.0 | 3 |
| incransom | 2 |
| The Green Blood Group | 1 |
| killsec | 1 |
| payload | 1 |
| apt73/bashe | 1 |
| tengu | 1 |
| qilin | 1 |

## Sectors most represented

| Sector | Count |
|---|---:|
| Gouvernement | 2 |
| Énergie | 2 |
| Compagnies aériennes | 2 |
| Aviation | 1 |
| Média | 1 |
| Juridique | 1 |
| Banque | 1 |
| Fintech | 1 |
| Service public | 1 |
| Hôtellerie | 1 |

## Methodology

The figures are derived once from `victims_FR.md`, checked against `victims.md`, and reused in the reports, comparisons and STIX bundle. A multi-country incident counts once globally; country occurrences may therefore exceed the global total. The corpus measures documented AFRINTEL visibility, not the actual prevalence of cyberattacks.

[Victim records](./victims.md)
